message:
11 wedding costs couples forget to budget for:

• vendor tips
• dress and suit alterations
• delivery, setup and service fees
• the marriage license
• an overtime or weather backup buffer
• postage for invitations
• welcome bags and favors
• hair and makeup trials
• vendor meals on the day
• transportation and parking
• wedding insurance

The free budget calculator lists them all, so you can set money aside before they surprise you.
